name: Itak
source:
The prince of Nakoku, neighbor nation to Shyahoro. He is [url=/c52606]Soyankekur’s[/url] nephew, and  [url=/c37803]Atuy's[/url] cousin. Though young, he is passionate and sincere, and has earned the trust of his subjects. Unbeknownst to [url=/c37803]Atuy[/url], their mothers have arranged for the two to be married...

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/truth/home.html]official site[/url]]
